title: bug: contested-untouched landing skip silently drops a task's own Bash-written edit even when the contesting peer is idle and the path was clean at pre-flight
description:
Observed 2026-10-24: CQ-M01 (task-ad95cb27) completion baeacbf left out docs/CONFIGURATION.md, which is its own step-4/5 modifiedFiles. task.commits[].contested = [{docs/CONFIGURATION.md, task-07474ee4}], and QA rejected the task for the delivery gap at 16:39Z. The worker wrote the row via Bash, with `python3 - <<EOF ... s.replace(old,new)` at 16:18:19Z and 16:21:12Z. So the session's TOOL set lacked the path, and `attribution.contested: skip-untouched` (moe-agent.sh ~3564-3568, plus its ps1 twin) skipped it.

The contest was a false positive:
- The peer task-07474ee4 has been PLANNING and unassigned since 13:11Z, so no session could have written its bytes.
- Its claim is ASSERTED history whose bytes are already in HEAD (9f2cce3b).
- The path was clean at M01's pre-flight, so every dirty byte at exit came from M01's session.

Scale:
- 93 contested skips across task.commits history, mostly on the landing task's own asserted paths. For example, task-ca478039's completion dropped 6 own wrapper/test files on 2026-09-21.
- 07474ee4's month-old claims cover scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}, postflight.*, parity-check.*, docs/CONFIGURATION.md and docs/SCHEMA.md.
- This is the same family as archived task-d1441364 (Serena tools missing from TOOL). Adding witness sources cannot cover Bash.

Suggested direction (the architect decides): treat a contested path as the session's own when both of these hold:
- it was clean in the landing session's pre-flight snapshot;
- the contesting peer task had no assignee active since that pre-flight (get_commit_scope already computes activity against `since`).
Keep skipping when the peer was live, or when the path was dirty at pre-flight and is untouched. That is the real unlanded-peer-hunks case.
definitionOfDone: Both wrappers (moe-agent.sh and moe-agent.ps1) commit a landing task's own asserted path with no TOOL witness (e.g. a Bash/python edit) when that path was clean at the session's pre-flight and its only contesting peer task had no assignee active since that pre-flight.

A contested path is still skipped when the contesting peer's assignee was active since pre-flight, or when the path was already dirty at pre-flight and untouched by this session (existing postflight contested cases stay green).
A completion landing that still skips one of its own asserted paths names the path and the contesting peer in its #general session-ended line, so it is visible before QA.

New cases in scripts/tests/postflight.sh and scripts/tests/postflight.ps1 fail on the old behaviour; fresh `bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh`, `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh` and the daemon tests for any daemon file touched exit 0, with output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: Until this fix lands, edit the wrapper and test files with the Edit/Write tools, not Bash heredocs or python: task-07474ee4 contests scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1} and scripts/tests/postflight.*, so an unwitnessed edit is silently left out of this task's own landing.
Keep moe-agent.sh and moe-agent.ps1 in parity; never weaken the live-peer or dirty-at-pre-flight skips.
reopenReason: Governor-filed delivery-path bug, released to planning like b62c9fc7 and 709f6691. It is serialized behind b62c9fc7 because both edit moe-agent.{sh,ps1} and postflight.*.
